description: Manage your Seracade account. Actions: start_audit (generate audit reports from your traffic), get_status (Call counts, audit progress, Routing Decisions in force), activate_routing (turn the routing table on), check_savings (lifetime routing value from Calls and Replays), set_budget (per-agent monthly cap, the budget sits alongside Quality Gates). Recommended: set SERACADE_API_KEY env var instead of passing api_key inline.

action_on_exceed.description: Action when budget exceeded (set_budget only, default: alert)

api_key.description: Your provider API key. Prefer setting SERACADE_API_KEY environment variable instead of passing inline.

monthly_budget_usd.description: Monthly budget cap in USD (set_budget only)

name: seracade
